name: ratio_is_composed_not_recomputed
why: Pins the composition rule this toolkit's skill states: prefer composing existing metrics over recomputing. A ratio recomputed as its own simple metric is the bug that produces two different conversion rates in one company, and it re-divides wrongly at every grain except the one it was written for — `avg(ratio)` instead of `sum(num)/sum(den)`. The proposal must also stay inside the columns the mart actually has.

input.mart_detail:
model:fct_revenue [grain: one day x segment x plan]
Columns: revenue_date(event_time), net_amount(money_amount), customer_segment(VARCHAR), plan_tier(VARCHAR), currency_code(VARCHAR), gross_amount(DECIMAL(38,2)), payment_count(BIGINT)

No metric currently references this mart. Where two of its measures stand in a part-to-whole relationship, a ratio metric composed from them is preferred to a new metric that recomputes the division in SQL.
